title: CRA Art. 14(7) reporting-body directory
description: Two separate things, deliberately not merged. (1) `establishmentRule` — the CASCADE from CRA Art. 14(7) that determines WHICH Member State's coordinator CSIRT a manufacturer reports to. The CRA states this rule in full, so it is transcribed here and is authoritative. (2) `memberStates` — the DIRECTORY of which CSIRT each Member State has designated as coordinator. The CRA does NOT enumerate these; they are designated nationally (NIS2 Art. 10). Every entry therefore starts with `coordinator: null`, which means NOT YET SOURCED — a known gap, never 'this state has no CSIRT' and never 'nothing is owed'. A null coordinator must render as unresolved, and must never be treated as an absence of obligation.

primary.description: Ordered tests for a manufacturer WITH a main establishment in the Union. First match wins.

fallbackWhenNoUnionEstablishment.description: Ordered tests for a manufacturer with NO main establishment in the Union (Art. 14(7) points (a)-(d)). First match wins.

benchmarkRegimes.description: Non-EU locales where the CRA timeline is followed as a BENCHMARK rather than an obligation. These carry no coordinator CSIRT and can never make a case filable — `regulatory` is the only track that files. They exist because the discipline has value where no EU body is owed a report (underwriting and procurement benchmarking being the operator's stated reason), and because rendering such a locale as 'nothing owed' would be wrong in substance even though it is right in law.

regime.description: Never 'regulatory'. A benchmark locale delegates no body and files nothing.

rationale.description: WHY the CRA timeline is applied here. An operator judgement, recorded as such.

source.description: Where the rationale came from. Absent = operator assertion, not an external finding.

coordinator.description: null = NOT YET SOURCED. This is a declared gap and must render as unresolved, never as 'no body' and never as 'nothing owed'.

endpoint.description: The electronic notification end-point Art. 14(7) requires the report to be submitted through.

source.description: Where this designation was read from. A designation with no source is not a designation.

verifiedAt.description: When the source was last re-read. Staleness is reported, never assumed fresh.

id.description: Stable id so a resolution can cite WHICH limb of the cascade decided it.

test.description: The determination in the regulation's own terms.
